criteria.name: UX quality
evidence: vp-06 PASS: `python todo.py --help` exit 0; stdout contains `list      List all tasks in insertion order.` (consistent style with `add` subcommand). `python todo.py list --help` exit 0 with valid usage line.
vp-04 test_list_output_to_stdout PASS: stdout receives output, stderr is zero bytes on success (pipeline-safe).

criteria.name: Robustness
evidence: vp-03 PASS: empty TMPDIR (no .todo.json) -> exit 0, stdout=0 bytes, stderr=0 bytes, no traceback.
vp-04 test_list_missing_file_exits_zero PASS + test_list_empty_file_exits_zero PASS (handles both missing and 0-byte file).

criteria.name: Craft
evidence: vp-04 PASS: 5 list cases green via `python -m unittest discover -s tests` (11/11 total — 6 S01 cases unchanged, 5 S02 cases added).
vp-05 PASS: `ruff check todo.py tests/` -> All checks passed; `mypy --strict todo.py tests/` -> Success no issues; todo.py imports are stdlib-only (argparse/json/os/sys/datetime/pathlib).

criteria.name: Functionality
evidence: vp-01 PASS: HOME=$(mktemp -d) + `python todo.py add buy milk` (rc=0) + `python todo.py list` (rc=0) prints exactly one line matching `^\[1\] buy milk \(2026-05-13T.*\+00:00\)$`.
vp-02 PASS: three successive adds produce three list lines: `[1] task one (...)`, `[2] task two (...)`, `[3] task three (...)` — insertion order preserved.

Cross-sprint regression: S01's 6 tests (test_add_first_task, test_add_increments_id, test_add_no_description_exits_nonzero, test_add_empty_file_succeeds, test_importable_without_side_effects, test_multiword_description_persisted) all still PASS at HEAD 7ca4bba — no regression to add.

vacuous_pass_check.mock_honesty: PASS — vp-04 tests use real tempfile + real os.environ['TODO_FILE'] injection and call real todo.main() (no mocked collaborators). vp-01/vp-02 invoke todo.py as real subprocesses. test_list_single_task seeds data via S01 add subcommand (real cross-sprint exercise, not a mock).
vacuous_pass_check.cross_sprint_regression: PASS — S01 schema (list of {id, description, timestamp}) consumed unchanged; all 6 S01 tests still green at 7ca4bba; vp-01/vp-02 chain add->list end-to-end at user-observable level.
vacuous_pass_check.edge_case_coverage: PASS — missing file (vp-03 + unit), empty 0-byte file (unit), stderr cleanliness (unit), --help (vp-06).

checks.named_hidden_decision: JSON file at ~/.todo.json (or TODO_FILE env override) hides storage from subcommand handlers.
checks.interface_depth: Helper boundary (_todo_path / _load_tasks / _save_tasks) reused by both cmd_add and cmd_list — adding the second subcommand deepened the module rather than shallowing it (C5 two-adapter rule satisfied).
checks.size_sanity: 131 LOC — well within the 200-2000 LOC band for a single CLI module.
checks.stdlib_only: PASS — imports: argparse, json, os, sys, datetime, pathlib (all stdlib).
